title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics contextual enrichment and SLO-linked hints
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds contextual SLO hints to on-call diagnostics, improves relevance ranking for runbook suggestions, and enriches telemetry for post-incident analysis.
description:
Context and motivation: On-call responders frequently need quick, SLO-aware hints in the diagnostics surfaced by incident-bot. This PR enriches the oncall diagnostics payload with contextual SLO links, inferred impact summaries, and heuristic hints that prioritize runbooks tied to the affected SLOs. The goal is to reduce mean time to mitigation by surfacing the most relevant runbooks and remediation steps first.

What this PR does: - Adds an oncall context enricher that correlates alert tags and metric series with SLOs from the SLO Toolkit. - Attaches SLO summary snippets (slo_name, objective, current_error_budget) and direct runbook links to diagnostics messages. - Implements a lightweight ranking signal that boosts runbooks historically used for similar incidents. - Emits telemetry events for ranking decisions to aid future tuning.

Checklist: - [x] SLO lookup integration and caching implemented - [x] Runbook ranking heuristic added - [x] Unit tests for enricher and ranking - [x] End-to-end test against staging incident payloads - [x] Docs updated (runbook hints and configuration) - [x] Telemetry and metrics emitted for A/B analysis

Backward compatibility and rollout: The enricher is behind a feature flag (oncall.slo_enrichment) and defaults to off for customers without SLO Toolkit configured. We will rollout with a canary on staging and 10% production traffic, monitor relevance metrics and error rates, then increase rollout. No schema breaks to existing diagnostics payloads (new optional fields added).

Migration notes: Operators can opt-out by disabling oncall.slo_enrichment or setting a minimal ranking threshold. The caching layer respects TTLs configured in SLO Toolkit settings.

Related: Linear ENG-4621, ENG-4703. See design doc: /docs/design/oncall-slo-enrichment.md (internal).
commits_summary: feat: add SLO context enricher and ranking; test: add unit tests for enricher and ranking; chore: add feature flag and config; docs: document runbook hinting and rollout; perf: improve SLO cache hit path
review_comments: Ethan: Requested stronger tests around cache expiry and a warning log when SLO lookup fails; Riley: Asked for a safety timeout on external SLO API calls and suggested feature flag gating in config; Samir: Approved pending minor telemetry naming changes. Author replies: Added cache expiry unit tests, implemented timeout with circuit-breaker, and standardized telemetry event name to 'oncall.slo_hint.rank_decision'.
ci_summary: Checks: build: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests (staging mock): pass; lint: pass; e2e-oncall: pass. One flaky e2e run was re-triggered and passed. Coverage reported: 87% on modified packages.
notes: Follow-up work: capture user feedback in a small oncall survey, add ML-backed ranking in a future iteration, and surface per-runbook success metrics to improve ranking quality.
impact_analysis: Expected reduction in time-to-first-remediation for SLO-related incidents. Additional CPU cost for enrichment is minimal due to caching; observe telemetry for per-request p90 latency changes.
testing_instructions: Enable feature flag oncall.slo_enrichment in staging, deploy incident-bot build, trigger a synthetic alert tied to a sample SLO, verify diagnostics message includes slo_name, objective, current_error_budget and runbook links, and check ranking telemetry emitted.
